notes.title: BlackShot Patch Notes 04.09.2020
notes.notes:
[h1]New Mode: Knife Challenge Mode[/h1]
-Knife Challenge Mode is team-based. All players start only with their equipped melee weapon.

-Every 4 melee kills, you will be upgraded with a new weapon (see the list below), with more powerful weapons at higher tiers.

-These kills carry over even if you yourself are killed, so they don't have to be consecutive in order to reach new tiers.

-If you are killed, you will respawn with your melee weapon, and you can only acquire weapon tiers higher than the ones you have already surpassed.

-If any player on either team is more than 4 weapon tiers ahead of you, you will trigger a "Berserk" state. While in this state, you only need 1 melee kill to reach the next weapon tier.

[h2]Weapon Tiers (All weapons contain 1x magazine):
[/h2]
1- Glock21
2- Glock18
3- Frag Grenade
4- AWP Stealth

notes.title: CS 82 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1] BETA SEASON 2 STARTS NOW! [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/dd0ff2cfac28324d34b85f822315f2126b7d4953.jpg[/img]

Lock and load, Mercenaries, Season 2 of the Competitive Mode BETA is here. Several tweaks have been made to the Competitive Mode systems following the feedback received so far, the most exciting being the introduction of Team Flag Match (TFM) into matchmaking! The number of maps for each mode has also need increased from 2 to 3, adding some much-requested variety into the mix. Finally, every match in Competitive Mode now offers 200% EXP and BP, giving even more incentive to fight through the ranks.

New weapons and weekly missions are available with this update too, plus a red-hot Goldbox, the all-new Plaza map, and much more detailed below.
_____________________________________________________________

[h1] UP CLOSE & PERSONAL WEAPONS [/h1]

Stand your ground with the Desert Eagle Legion or swing for a grand slam with the gruesome Slugger baseball bat - both are guaranteed to keep your foes at a distance, and are available now in the Shop.
_____________________________________________________________

[h1] DESERT EAGLE LEGION  [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/58d7220419f4d048bb8c4a8294143707a9182471.jpg[/img]

Stats

Damage: 5.8
Fire Rate: 6.7
Weight: 1.6
Magazine: 10
Accuracy: 5.6

[h1] SLUGGER [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/9ed199ed533d0a7f782411e946334e4db8b8313b.png[/img]

Stats

Damage: 9.1
Fire Rate: 4.9
Weight: 2.0
Magazine: (0)
Accuracy: 7.0
_____________________________________________________________

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/29bc8f1d19b88d9b52810116ec8882d6d5239319.jpg[/img]

[h1] LUCKY BOX BLOWOUT [/h1]

Log in everyday during Season 2 to receive a Lucky Draw Box, containing an assortment of valuable weapons, gear, and characters. The more days you play, the more chances you have to win, as every fifth day you will receive multiple prizes, all the way up to 20 Lucky Boxes!

_____________________________________________________________

[h1] FIRESTORM GOLDBOX [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/ff3083ac75500416a5765058d3ba1b5b5751f969.jpg[/img]

Competitive Mode is heating up with fiery gear from the latest Goldboxes! This time round the red-hot AWP VTG Blaze is back in the spotlight, accompanied by the classic HK-416 Omega, defiant G36 Graffiti, glittering SCAR Aurum, and deadly Rayne premium character. Burn away your competition with these exclusive weapons, gear items, and characters, available now for a limited time!

_____________________________________________________________

[h1] INTRODUCING PLAZA SD [/h1]

Set in a sprawling outdoor mall, Plaza SD is the latest new map added to Search & Destroy Mode. Fight through the plaza’s open shops, long corridors, and beyond, using the several intertwining paths around the plant sites to your advantage.

This new map comes with its own set of achievements, awarding bonus BP on completion - conquer all three to receive a shiny new Slugger [7D]!

Frugal Shopper I          Complete 5 Matches in the Map Plaza SD
Shopping Spree II        Complete 25 Matches in the Map Plaza SD
Shop 'Til You Drop III   Complete 100 Matches in the Map Plaza SD
_____________________________________________________________

[h1] Map Boosts [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/f27d3b15f2522e66974320ad93b39f7a42b7e799.jpg[/img]

This new Competitive Season comes with another selection of helpful map boosts to optimize your time on the battlefield!

Maps below will have 300% EXP and 200% BP until further notice:

•    Plaza
•    Office
•    Titan Valley
•    Hunt TFM
•    Ballroom
_____________________________________________________________

[h1] GM FLAG & BOMB FESTIVAL - COMMUNITY EVENT [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/e906c51e75846e9b16097259cb942b4e31af119e.jpg[/img]

Celebrate the addition of TFM to Competitive Mode with the GM Team! Join the GMs in Competitive matchmaking every Friday during Season 2 for a chance at random BSC weapon prizes. As in the previous events, if you win or receive MVP, you’ll get even better loot!

These events will run every Friday from April 27th to May 25.
_____________________________________________________________

notes.title: [Update] Steam Sign-up Issues
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/cc72cded1adecc4dada06b4262b94ee0f511ec25.jpg[/img]

Hello Mercenaries,
Our team is aware of the 3 issues happening with the Steam Sign-up process.

[b]Authentication Error[/b]
- Game launcher asks for an ID and Password. When you insert the information and press start you'll receive the error.

[b]Certification Error -- This issue has been fixed[/b]
- After inserting the information to create your account you'll receive a script Error 

[b]User Inquiry Issue[/b]
- After creating your account the launcher will update itself and ask the user to create a new account again


If you are experiencing any of those issues, please contact us at support@blackshot.com

We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience and support.

Regards,
Team BlackShot

We've applied some backend changes and worked with engineers in our IDC and developer teams to improve quality and stability of our servers.

You might still experience unusual loading delays and connection issues while the servers are adapting to the changes. If you have such issue, please let us know via Help Desk or email (support@blackshot.com) 

In oder to compensate you, we are currently running a Hot Time Event. Log in until 08.06. by 11:00 (CEST) and get the Black Package for 3 days. Check your inbox in game to receive it. 

Thank you,
